sentences.en: Linda is sixteen, but had no trouble passing for twenty.
sentences.zh: 琳达十六岁，但她冒充二十岁的成年人毫无困难。

sentences.en: I am sure of his passing the coming entrance examination.
sentences.zh: 我相信他能通过即将到来的入学考试。

sentences.en: Word is passing that the Prime Minister is seriously ill.
sentences.zh: 有传言说总理病情严重。
